content: अन्तर् {%ind.%} [अम्-अरन्-तुडागमश्च <ls>Uṇ. 5. 60</ls>, अमेस्तुट् च] .²1 (Used as a prefix to verbs and regarded as a preposition or गति) .³({%a%}) In the middle, between; in, into, inside; ˚हन्, ˚धा, ˚गम्, ˚भू, ˚इ, ˚ली <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) Under. .²2 (Used adverbially) .³({%a%}) Between, betwixt, amongst, within; in the middle or interior, inside (<ab>opp.</ab> बहिः); अदह्यतान्तः <ls>R. 2. 32</ls> burnt within himself, at heart; अन्तरेव विहरन् दिवानिशम् <ls>R. 19. 6</ls> in the palace, in the harem; so ˚भिन्नं भ्रमति हृदयम् <ls>Māl. 5. 20</ls>; अन्तर्विभेद <ls>Dk. 13</ls>; यदन्तस्तन्न जिह्वायाम् <ls>Pt. 4. 88</ls>; अन्तर्यश्च मृग्यते <ls>V. 1. 1</ls> internally, in the mind. .³({%b%}) By way of seizing or holding; अन्तर्हत्वा गतः (हतं परिगृह्य). .²3 (As a separable preposition) .³({%a%}) In, into, between, in the middle, inside, within, (with <ab>loc.</ab>); निवसन्नन्तर्दारुणि लङ्घ्यो वह्निः <ls>Pt. 1. 31</ls>; अन्तरादित्ये <ls>Ch. Up.</ls>; अन्तर्वेश्मनि <ls>Ms. 7. 223</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 301</ls>; अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु <ls>Rv. 1. 23. 19</ls>. अप्सु मे सोमोऽब्रवीदन्तर् विश्वानि भेषजा {%<ab>ibid.</ab>%} .³({%b%}) Between (with <ab>acc.</ab>) <ab>Ved.</ab> अन्तर्मही बृहती रोदसीमे <ls>Rv. 7. 87. 2</ls>; अन्तर्देवान् मर्त्यांश्च <ls n="Rv.">8. 2. 4</ls>; हिरण्मय्योर्ह कुश्योरन्तरवहित आस <ls>Śat. Br.</ls> .³({%c%}) In, into, inside, in the interior, in the midst (with <ab>gen.</ab>); प्रतिबलजलधेरन्तरौर्वायमाणे <ls>Ve. 3. 7</ls>; अन्तःकञ्चुकिकञ्चुकस्य <ls>Ratn. 2. 3</ls>; बहिरन्तश्च भूतानाम् <ls>Bg. 13. 15</ls>; त्वमग्ने सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरसि साक्षिवत् <ls>Y. 2. 104</ls>; लघुवृत्तितया भिदां गतं बहिरन्तश्च नृपस्य मण्डलम् <ls>Ki. 2. 53</ls>; अन्तरीपं यदन्तर्वारिणस्तटम् <ls>Ak.</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab> at the end; कूपान्तः पतितः <ls>Pt. 5</ls>; सभान्तः साक्षिणः प्राप्तान् <ls>Ms. 8. 79</ls>; दन्तान्तरधिष्ठितम् <ls>Ms. 5. 141</ls> between the teeth; उत्पित्सवोऽन्तर्नदभर्तुः <ls>Śi. 3. 77</ls>; also in compound with a following word; अहं सदा शरीरान्तर्वासिनी ते सरस्वती <ls>Ks. 4. 11</ls>. .²4 It is frequently used as the first member of compounds in the sense of ‘internally’, ‘inside’, ‘within’, ‘in the interior’, ‘having in the interior’, ‘filled with’, ‘having concealed within’, or in the sense of ‘inward’, ‘internal’, ‘secret’, ‘hidden’ <ab>&c.</ab>, forming Adverbial, Bahuvrīhi or Tatpuruṣa compounds; कुन्दमन्तस्तुषारम् (<ab>Bah. comp.</ab>) <ls>Ś. 5. 19</ls> filled with dew; ˚स्तोयम् (<ab>Bah. comp.</ab>) <ls>Me. 66</ls>; अन्तर्गिरि (<ab>Adv.</ab> <ab>comp.</ab>) <ls>Ki. 1. 34</ls>; ज्वलयति तनूमन्तर्दाहः (<ab>Tat. comp.</ab>) <ls>U. 3. 31</ls>; so ˚कोपः, ˚कोणः, ˚आकूतम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 It is also supposed to be a particle of assent (स्वीकारार्थक). ({%Note%}. In <ab>comp.</ab> the र् of अन्तर् is changed to a visarga before hard consonants, as अन्तःकरणम्, अन्तःस्थ <ab>&c.</ab>). [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%inter%}; <lang>Zend.</lang> {%antare%}; <lang>Goth.</lang> {%undar%}; <lang>Pers.</lang> {%andar%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%entos%}.]  .{@-कृ(क्रि)मिः@} a disease of worms in the body.
